summary: Two web tests stop depending on how fast a host runs. The replay browser e2e builds the conversation pane's module on the dev server before it waits for the page to request it, so the 10-second response wait no longer includes a cold build on a loaded host, and it prints how long the response took. The scroll viewport story drives the eased return from a clock it controls, with one branch for reduced motion and one that checks half of the 200ms is on the way and the full 200ms is the end. Test-only change.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no replay or stored data changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime compatibility change; the components are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No persisted state or recovery change.
